newsitem.title: USA: Corporate Express withers after EPS warning. [CORRECTED 20:20 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Corporate Express withers after EPS warning. [CORRECTED 20:20 GMT]

text.p: Corporate Express Inc shares cratered in furious Nasdaq trade Wednesday, with almost half the stock's market value vanishing in a selloff triggered by the company's expectation of weak fourth quarter results.
In late morning trade, about 28 million shares had traded in the 8-3/16 point decline to 10-1/8, a 45 percent loss.
The average daily trading volume is about 822,000 shares.
The bad news, announced early this morning, drove Corporate Express shares to the top of the Nasdaq net-loser, percentage-loser and most-actives lists.
Earnings for the quarter ended March 1 are expected to be $0.05 (corrects from $0.06) to $0.07 below the $0.16 per share First Call analysts' consensus estimate, the company said.
The Broomfield, Colo.-based office supply company reported a loss of $0.34 per share in the year-ago period, or $23.5 million, including $48.3 million in merger and non-recurring charges.
